data.action: 提着理发工具包，在夕阳逆光中漫步
data.description: 【澄闪 · 黄昏归途】夕阳余晖洒满维多利亚红砖小镇的石板路上，苏茜提着小巧的皮质理发工具包漫步在金色逆光中，粉红色的长发如丝绸般随风轻扬。她放慢脚步回眸望向你——「今天给小镇的老奶奶修剪了头发，她夸我手艺超棒哦！博士，我们一起慢慢走回舰上去吧。」
data.promptProse: Goldenglow strolls along the Victorian town's red-brick street with a small leather barber-tool bag, slowing to look back warmly as pink hair moves in the wind. White shirt, yellow ascot and dark pinafore retain her work outfit. The medium tracking view follows worn cobblestones past receding brick facades. Orange dusk backlight rims hair and bag edges, drawing her long shadow along the street while the nearer building sides remain cooler and shaded.
data.title: 澄闪 · 黄昏归途
